text: Hi! I'm Misa. And this charming voice next to me is...

text: Zenith. The platform. I remember things. Somebody has to.

text: Our owner got tired of re-explaining his projects to every new chat.

speaker: zenith
text: "Did the tests pass?" "When did we decide that?" Every. Single. Session.

speaker: misa
text: So now I just ask Zenith where we left off.

speaker: zenith
text: Open tasks, the last decision, the last verified test run. And whether it still counts. Spoiler: it doesn't. You changed the code.

speaker: misa
text: Verified, observed, or just reported. He keeps them apart.

speaker: zenith
text: A note saying "basically done" is a claim. Not evidence.

speaker: misa
text: When I want to think out loud, Gemma runs right here on the GPU. Nothing leaves the machine.

speaker: zenith
text: And I check every answer against the records. Invent a citation, and I replace it.

speaker: misa
text: Coding agents get a director, their own worktree, and a sandboxed verifier.

speaker: zenith
text: Claim "all tests pass" when they didn't? Blocked.

speaker: misa
